hero.title: Support for every mother, <accent>in her own language.</accent>
hero.subtitle: MumWell combines validated screening, a compassionate AI companion and a personal 90-day programme to help mothers through pregnancy and the first year after birth in English, Svenska, Deutsch, Français and Español.
hero.cardChatUser: I haven't slept properly in weeks and I feel so alone.
hero.cardChatAi: That sounds exhausting. You're not alone, let's take this one step at a time.

stats.title: Common, treatable and too often unseen
stats.body: Mental health conditions around pregnancy and birth affect mothers in every country. Unrecognised, they weigh on bonding, breastfeeding and infant care. With timely support, most women recover fully.

how.title: Stepped support, from first check-in to professional care
how.body: Light-touch self-help for everyone, more support when it's needed, and a clear route to health professionals and crisis services when it matters most.

steps.title: Screen
steps.body: A validated 10-question EPDS check-in, scored instantly with clear, compassionate next steps.

steps.title: Talk
steps.body: An empathetic AI companion that listens day or night and recognises signs of distress.

steps.title: Grow
steps.body: A personal 90-day programme of small daily actions for rest, recovery and bonding.

steps.title: Consult
steps.body: Voice consultations with nine AI specialists, each followed by a written summary.

steps.title: Connect
steps.body: Summaries to share with a midwife or doctor, and local helplines whenever care is urgent.

features.title: Care that fits into real life with a newborn

screening.title: Validated screening
screening.body: The EPDS questionnaire used by health services around the world, with clear next steps for every result.
points: The 10-item EPDS, scored the way clinicians score it
Plain-language results with a next step for every score
Any sign of self-harm immediately brings up crisis resources

companion.title: AI companion
companion.body: A warm, evidence-informed chat that remembers your conversation and recognises when you need urgent help.
points: Remembers your conversation, so you never have to repeat yourself
Recognises crisis language in all five languages
Gentle, non-judgemental replies in the language you choose

specialists.title: Voice consultations
specialists.body: Nine AI specialists, from obstetrics and lactation to mental health specialists that you can simply talk to.
points: From obstetrics, paediatrics and lactation to mental health and nutrition
Natural voices in English, Swedish, German, French and Spanish
A printable written summary after every consultation

programme.title: 90-day programme
programme.body: Personalised daily steps for rest, recovery, bonding and connection, adapted to your situation.
points: Tailored to your situation, support network and history
Foundation, Building and Thriving phases over 90 days
Daily tasks, reflections and optional email reminders

safety.title: Safety designed in, not added on
safety.body: Every message is checked for signs of crisis. When risk is detected, MumWell responds with care, shows the emergency and helpline numbers for the mother's country, and encourages her to reach someone she trusts.

flow.title: She reaches out
flow.body: A mother writes or speaks in her own language.

flow.title: Risk is recognised
flow.body: Crisis language is detected in five languages, alongside an AI risk assessment.

flow.title: Safety comes first
flow.body: The reply becomes calm, direct and focused on her immediate safety.

flow.title: Help is one tap away
flow.body: Local emergency and helpline numbers appear instantly.

does: Listens, reflects and offers evidence-informed coping strategies
Explains screening results in plain language
Signposts to professional and emergency care
doesnt: Replace midwives, doctors or mental health professionals
Sell, share or advertise with personal data
safety.aiNotice: People are always told when they are talking to an AI.

mood.title: How are you feeling right now?
mood.subtitle: There is no wrong answer. Noticing is the first step.
mood.hint: Choose the face that feels closest to how you are.
responses: Thank you for being honest. You deserve support, and you're not alone.
Low days happen. Small steps and a kind word to yourself count.
Okay is okay. Checking in with yourself matters.
That's good to hear. Notice what's helping today.
Wonderful. Hold on to this feeling and what brought it.

global.title: Your language. Your data. Your rights.
global.body: Wherever you are, MumWell protects you to the world's strictest privacy standards, including the EU's GDPR, and meets you in your own language.
points: The full experience including AI chat and voice in English, Swedish, German, French and Spanish
Explicit consent before any health data is processed
Download or permanently delete your data at any time
No advertising, tracking cookies or data selling ever
global.helplines: Emergency and helpline numbers for 15 countries across four continents

items.title: Safety first
items.body: Every conversation is checked for signs of crisis, with emergency and helpline numbers one tap away.

items.title: Evidence-informed
items.body: Built on validated tools and approaches such as CBT, behavioural activation and self-compassion.

items.title: Private by design
items.body: Only the data needed to help you, protected by consent, encryption in transit and your right to erase it.

items.title: Complements care
items.body: MumWell supports, but never replaces, midwives, GPs, health visitors and mental health professionals.

cta.title: You deserve to feel supported.
cta.body: Create a free account in under a minute and take the first gentle step today.
